    project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    position integer NOT NULL CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 49), PRIMARY KEY(page_id, project_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE public_status_page_checks (
    page_id uuid NOT NULL, project_id uuid NOT NULL, check_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES availability_checks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY(page_id, check_id), FOREIGN KEY(page_id, project_id) REFERENCES public_status_page_projects(page_id, project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )
CREATE INDEX public_status_page_projects_project_idx ON public_status_page_projects(project_id)
CREATE INDEX public_status_page_checks_check_idx ON public_status_page_checks(check_id)

CREATE TABLE notification_preferences (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    organization_id uuid REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    project_id uuid REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    preferences jsonb NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK ((user_id IS NULL) <> (organization_id IS NULL)),
    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT(user_id, organization_id, project_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE notification_daily_batches (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY, recipient text NOT NULL,
    schedule_time text NOT NULL, schedule_timezone text NOT NULL, due_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','delivered','suppressed','failed')),
    claim_token uuid, claimed_until timestamptz, attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL, last_error text, delivered_at timestamptz,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE(recipient, schedule_time, schedule_timezone, due_at)
  )

CREATE INDEX notification_daily_due_idx ON notification_daily_batches(next_attempt_at)
    WHERE status = 'pending'

CREATE TABLE notification_daily_items (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY, batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_daily_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    alert_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES alert_rules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    incident_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES incidents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    recipient_user_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    episode_at timestamptz NOT NULL, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL, billable boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    notification_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE(alert_id, incident_id, episode_at)
  )
CREATE INDEX notification_daily_items_batch_idx ON notification_daily_items(batch_id, incident_id)
CREATE INDEX notification_daily_items_cooldown_idx ON notification_daily_items(alert_id, notification_key, created_at)
CREATE INDEX notification_daily_items_incident_idx ON notification_daily_items(incident_id, episode_at)
CREATE INDEX notification_daily_items_project_idx ON notification_daily_items(project_id, batch_id)
CREATE INDEX notification_daily_items_user_idx ON notification_daily_items(recipient_user_id) WHERE recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX notification_daily_retention_idx ON notification_daily_batches(created_at)
CREATE INDEX notification_preferences_organization_idx ON notification_preferences(organization_id, project_id) WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX notification_preferences_project_idx ON notification_preferences(project_id) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE notification_daily_allowance_usage (
    batch_id uuid NOT NULL,
    project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    billable boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY(batch_id, project_id)
  )
CREATE INDEX notification_daily_allowance_project_idx ON notification_daily_allowance_usage(project_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE billing_checkout_attempts (
    organization_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    target_plan text NOT NULL CHECK (target_plan IN ('solo','team')),
    parameters jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(parameters) = 'object'),
    stripe_session_id text UNIQUE,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  )

CREATE TABLE billing_subscription_operations (
    organization_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    subscription_id text NOT NULL,
    customer_id text NOT NULL,
    kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('upgrade','capacity_increase','capacity_schedule','capacity_cancel','plan_schedule','plan_cancel')),
    intent jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(intent) = 'object'),
    parameters jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(parameters) = 'object'),
    resource_id text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    completed_at timestamptz
  )
